Certainty is how sure the model is that a product is the ingredient: 5/5 at 98% or more · 4/5 95–97% · 3/5 90–94% · 2/5 80–89% · 1/5 under 80%, usually a substitute. Checked means you marked it OK.
Receipt prices: Open Prices by Open Food Facts, licensed ODbL 1.0 — crowdsourced receipts and shelf photos from German stores.
